source_binding.mechanism: open-set unknown rejection plus selective-classification abstention

public_sources.claim_used: Open-set recognition distinguishes the closed-set assumption from settings where test inputs may belong to unknown classes rather than forcing every input into a known class.
Reject-option/selective classification explicitly permits abstention instead of prediction when an observation should not be classified under the available decision rule.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No open-set classifier, ML runtime, external model, hosted service, cloud compute, or user execution is used. Public sources supply only reject/abstain semantics.
source_binding.chat_native_reduction: Require exact-one-match against the current predeclared evidence taxonomy. Zero-match evidence is UNCLASSIFIED and multi-match evidence is AMBIGUOUS; both abstain from promotion. Any taxonomy expansion is a separately sealed decision that activates only in a later generation, and the triggering anomaly cannot retroactively validate that new generation.

scope_limit: Constructed role-local taxonomy trace only. Reject/abstain avoids forcing unknown evidence into known strata but does not solve reliable discovery or naming of novel regimes.
unresolved_child: Taxonomy expansion can itself be unstable if one anomaly creates a permanent new stratum. A later leaf should test support thresholds/cluster persistence before a novel stratum becomes durable selection structure.

quota_cost_assessment.repository_transport_note: Repository API is lightweight state/evidence transport only; rate-limit interruption is checkpoint/retryable and API volume is not used as compute.
